input.quote: (viii) it is the rightful owner or licensee of all intellectual property rights to the Service, the Auction Platform and products delivered hereunder;
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no IP or data ownership provision. The only proprietary-rights language is a warranty that Kubient owns the IP in the Service, Auction Platform and "products delivered hereunder" (p0040), a trademark/logo carve-out (p0065), and a clause making AP "solely liable" for its Content and the IP rights therein (p0025) without confirming AP owns them. Nothing allocates ownership of deliverables or work product prepared for AP, and nothing addresses AP's data (including Requests sent to Kubient and visitor data Kubient collects and stores under p0035). That leaves the vendor warranty as the only ownership statement touching delivered products and gives AP no licence back to embedded Kubient materials. We therefore added a short IP and data section: AP retains its Content, Properties and data and owns deliverables (Kubient assigns), Kubient keeps the Auction Platform and its pre-existing tools with a perpetual, royalty-free licence back for embedded materials, Kubient's data use is limited to providing the Services, and no joint ownership is created.

proposal.summary: Add an IP and data ownership section: AP owns its Content, Properties and data plus deliverables (Kubient assigns), Kubient keeps its platform with a licence back, no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement never allocates ownership of intellectual property or data, so we added a section confirming that we retain our Content, Properties and data and own deliverables created for us, while Kubient keeps the Auction Platform and its pre-existing tools and grants us a licence to anything of its own embedded in a deliverable. This reflects our position that we own what we pay for and what we put in, with no assignment or joint ownership of our IP or data.

ops.text: 13A. Intellectual Property and Data. (a) As between the Parties, Customer exclusively owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Properties, the Requests, and all data and information provided by, or collected from, Customer, the Properties or their visitors in connection with the Services (collectively, "Customer Data"), together with all deliverables and work product prepared for Customer under this Agreement or any Exhibit, and Kubient hereby assigns to Customer all right, title and interest it may have in such deliverables and work product. (b) Kubient retains all right, title and interest in the Auction Platform and its other pre-existing or generally applicable technology, tools and know-how, and to the extent any such Kubient materials are incorporated in a deliverable, Kubient grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable license to use, modify and exploit the same as part of that deliverable for Customer's business purposes. (c) Kubient may use Customer Data solely as necessary to provide the Services during the Term, and nothing in this Agreement grants Kubient any ownership of, or joint ownership in, any Customer intellectual property or Customer Data.
